entity.summary: South Korean centralized digital-asset exchange operated by Infinity Exchange Korea Co., Ltd., providing current spot markets, deposits, withdrawals, mobile trading, and account-based order execution.
entity.notes: Current first-party company and exchange pages identify Infinity Exchange Korea Co., Ltd., VASP registration number 2024-03, and an ISMS certification window through April 2028. Current independent market data reports recently updated spot markets. No exact public launch date is asserted because the reviewed sources do not establish a reliable day-level launch marker.
